caption: A negative position counts from the end
A list of positions applies f at each independently

expr: [MapAt, h, [List, [List, a, b, c], [List, d, e], f, g], 2]
expected: [List, [List, a, b, c], [h, [List, d, ExponentialE]], f, g]

expr: [MapAt, h, [List, [List, a, b, c], [List, d, e], f, g], -3]
expected: [List, [List, a, b, c], [h, [List, d, ExponentialE]], f, g]

expr: [MapAt, h, [List, [List, a, b, c], [List, d, e], f, g], [List, [List, 2], [List, 1]]]
expected: [List, [h, [List, a, b, c]], [h, [List, d, ExponentialE]], f, g]

wolfram.note: position List[1] given TWICE in the position spec should apply f twice at that position (f[f[a]]) per Wolfram; ours applies f once per distinct position (dedupes via a Set), so a repeated position only gets one application
